metadata.description: Custom Claude Code skills for frontend work: commits, PRs, tests, vulnerabilities.

plugins.name: team-skills
plugins.description: All team skills in one install: commit messages, PR descriptions, frontend unit tests, npm vulnerability fixes.

plugins.name: add-unit-test-frontend
plugins.description: Add or review unit tests (Testing Library on Vitest or Jest) in React frontend projects.

plugins.name: commit-message
plugins.description: Suggest commit message variants tagged with the task number from the branch.

plugins.name: fix-unit-test-frontend
plugins.description: Fix failing frontend unit tests after deciding whether the test or the code is wrong.

plugins.name: pr-description
plugins.description: Fill in the repo's PR template for the current branch.

plugins.name: resolve-vulnerabilities
plugins.description: Resolve High and Critical npm dependency vulnerabilities from osv-scanner or npm audit.
